open.text: he sat so still, *ants* built a hill over him.

script: A robber held up travelers to feed his family. One day he stopped a sage, who asked him one question. Will your family share the weight of what you do? The robber ran home and asked. They said no. It was all his. His deeds were his alone. And so were the next ones. So the sage gave him a name of God to repeat. He sat so still, ants built a hill over him. He rose as Valmiki, the poet who wrote the Ramayana. That's karma. Not payback. Action. What you do, you become.
